name: LinearMask-GS
definition: A learned-mask pruning framework for compact 3D Gaussian Splatting that replaces the Gumbel-Sigmoid activation with a linear increment activation to keep mask values in a mid-confidence regime, producing a stable unimodal distribution for reliable importance ranking.
summary: LinearMask-GS is a 3D Gaussian Splatting pruning framework using linear increment activation to maintain stable mask values and ensure reliable importance ranking.
